rules.C1Exception: one raw item from T0 yields one basic refined item
rules.C2Sourcing: two raw items from T0; never refined inputs from T1
rules.T2Sourcing: two lower-complexity products from T1 and/or T2
rules.productIdentity: immediate unordered ingredient pair; nested structure retained
rules.storage: raw items use one space; product items use complexity spaces
rules.inputStorageAllocation: half of goods space, weighted by recipe quantity times item space
